metadata.description: Microsoft Entra stale user tracking - Phase 1 monitor and report. Deploys the Azure resources; run infra/identity.bicep afterwards to create the Entra groups and grant read-only Graph permissions.
Short prefix used in resource names.
Log Analytics retention in days for the evidence table.
Time of day (HH:mm) for the daily report-only run.
Time zone for the daily schedule (Windows time zone ID).
Optional email address for alert notifications. Leave empty to create alert rules without an action group.
Deploy alert rules (missing daily run, run failure, control defect, Automation job failure).
Raw URL of the runbook script. Change only when hosting a fork.
Do not change. Used to schedule the first run for the day after deployment.

logAlerts.name: missing-daily-run
logAlerts.description: No RunCompleted evidence in the last 24 hours. Expected to fire until the first scheduled run completes.

logAlerts.name: run-failed
logAlerts.description: Fail-closed run failure or blocked action recorded.
logAlerts.query: EntraStaleUser_CL | where RecordType in ('RunFailed','Blocked') or ActionStatus in ('Failed','PartialSuccess')

logAlerts.name: control-defect
logAlerts.description: Excluded or manual-review account classified as threshold reached or disable candidate.
logAlerts.query: EntraStaleUser_CL | where RecordType == 'Evaluation' | where Disposition in ('DisableCandidate','CandidateReportOnly') and (Excluded == true or ManualReview == true)

properties.description: Entra stale user monitor. Phase 1 report-only by default.
Daily report-only evaluation. Linked to the runbook by infra/identity.bicep.
The stale user runbook job failed, was suspended, or was stopped.

nextStep.value: [format('az deployment group create -g {0} --template-file infra/identity.bicep -p automationAccountName={1}', resourceGroup().name, format('aa-{0}', parameters('namePrefix')))]
